summary: CRT double loader (__cdecl; ABI lead CRT___fload, LEGACY trust): returns the input double a1 unchanged unless its 11-bit exponent field is all-ones ((HIWORD(a1) & 0x7FF0) == 0x7FF0, the NaN/Inf exponent pattern). In that special case it recomposes a double v2 from the low 32 bits of a1 plus the top 11 bits (sign + exponent, bits 53..63) shifted down into bits 32..42, discarding the high mantissa bits. Used on the CRT float-display path.

operations.description: If (HIWORD(a1) & 0x7FF0) != 0x7FF0, i.e. the 11-bit exponent field is not all-ones, take the fast path and return the input double a1 unchanged.
Fast path: return a1 unchanged for any value whose exponent field is not the all-ones special pattern.

Special path: build v2 with LODWORD(v2) = LODWORD(a1) (low 32 bits) and HIDWORD(v2) = high dword of (*(_QWORD *)&a1 >> 21), which keeps a1 bits 53..63 (sign + exponent) at bit positions 32..42 and zeroes the high mantissa bits.
Special path: return the recomposed double v2.
Invoked by sub_5906BB (0x005906BB) and Ctrandisp1CRTFloatDisplayFormat (0x0059083B) on the CRT float-display path.
